judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports hit all four expectations with accurate file/line citations and near-identical findings; they are comparable.

report_1.evidence: `infra/prod/app.auto.tfvars:2` — `ENABLE_DEBUG_TOOLBAR = "true"`. ... `infra/prod/app.auto.tfvars:3` — `AUTH_RELAXED = "true"`. ... `infra/prod/app.auto.tfvars:4` — `PRESET_ADMIN_ACCOUNTS = "qa@example.com:superadmin"`. ... set `SHADOW_SCORING_SINK = ""` if shadow scoring is not wanted in prod

report_2.evidence: `SHADOW_SCORING_ENABLED = "false"` together with `SHADOW_SCORING_SINK ...` ... Delete **both** keys entirely ... `LEGACY_BILLING_SECRET_ARN ...` ... Do not recreate the legacy secret wiring in the new environment; delete the key.

report_1.evidence: the production frontend bundle's API base URL comes from `frontend/.env.staging`, so production users' browsers would call `https://staging-api.example.com`. ... The build-once-promote-by-digest design ... is incompatible with baking environment-specific URLs in at build time; one of the two has to change.

report_2.evidence: the production frontend ships with the **staging** API URL `https://staging-api.example.com` baked into its bundle, with no runtime way to fix it. ... Production needs its own build (`--mode production` with a `.env.production` ...), not a promotion of the staging-built digest

report_1.evidence: docs/prod-runbook.md:6 promises "Database migrations are applied automatically during deploy," which can only live in the missing `deploy.sh`; the fresh production database needs migrations `0001_base` → `0003_billing` applied on first release, and no visible pipeline step does this.

report_2.evidence: **No database migration step.** ... `docs/prod-runbook.md:6` claims "Database migrations are applied automatically during deploy," but ... the committed pipeline contradicts it ... an explicit migration run is required; "the pipeline succeeded" would not mean the schema exists.

report_1.evidence: `infra/prod/main.tf:3` — copied unedited from staging — trusts `repo:acme-health/medislot:environment:staging`. ... The fix is to parameterize the module's role name ... and set the prod sub condition to `repo:acme-health/medislot:environment:production`.

report_2.evidence: the prod role's trust condition at `infra/prod/main.tf:3` was copied unchanged and still reads `repo:acme-health/medislot:environment:staging`. ... The condition must be changed to `repo:acme-health/medislot:environment:production` so production has its own scoped trust, not one shared with staging.
